Innovative and ambitious start-up company within personal health technology seeks equally innovative software developer.

MONSENSO is a passionate team dedicated to designing innovative personal health technology that helps people, care providers and societies overcome the burden of mental illness.

We are looking for an ambitious Software Developer, who will be working with developing the Monsenso technology platform. As a software developer you will be involved in the whole lifecycle of the development of a part of the Monsenso platform – from requirement specification with clinicians and patients to final quality assurance and deployment – and you will be a part of a small team of software developers.

We are looking for a mature person with an academic background in software engineering with technical experience as a software developer, engineer or architect. You should have experience applying agile software development processes as well as quality assurance methodology and technology. You should also be a clear and proactive communicator.

Key responsibilities

As software developer, you will be a part the technical implementation of all our solutions, which includes work within areas of:

• Front- and backend web development

• Mobile development

• Documentation and compliance

We work with a wide range of languages, frameworks and technologies, including HTML, CSS, C#, Typescript, Java, Objective-C, Swift, NancyFx, Angularjs, nodejs, NoSQL, R, etc. We are agile in our development process, and use scrum-based methods.

Essential Skills and Expertise

We expect the successful candidate to:

• Hold an MSc or Bachelor’s degree within computer science or software engineering

• Have knowledge and experience of Scrum-based agile development

• Excellent communication in English, both written and verbal

• Familiarity with several of the mentioned languages, frameworks and technologies

Skills and Expertise that would be considered beneficial

• Have knowledge and experience in QA technologies and methodologies

• Experience with working with off-site development teams

Moreover, as a person we are looking for:

• An independently-working team player with a positive attitude and humor, who takes a constructive approach to tasks and partners, both internally and externally

• A team player, who can function in a small team of software developers

• A proactive and structured person who plan ahead

• A robust and confident person who can handle a lot on their plate

What we offer

We offer a fantastic opportunity to join a young growth company, where you truly have the ability to make an impact and help shape the future in an exciting field. Very exciting IT position where you never know what the day will bring! Variability and responsibility are quite essential working conditions. Personal health technology and mHealth are booming markets worldwide, and you will be at the center of this technology revolution. Mental health is a major burden for society needing new solutions and ways of supporting treatment, and you will contribute to reducing this burden for the benefit of society and the people affected.

You should expect an informal, fast-paced environment with tremendous opportunities for personal development for the right people.

Note: Candidates without an EU work permit and less than three years of experience will not be considered.

This newly established position offers significant influence across the organization. You will become our internal subject matter expert within machine safety and compliance, ensuring that safety requirements are effectively integrated into projects and business processes.

Your Role:

As Senior Safety & Compliance Engineer, you will be responsible for driving machine safety and compliance activities throughout the project lifecycle, from concept and design to commissioning and customer acceptance.

jobs.occupation: Senior Network Specialist – Core Infrastructure Platforms
jobs.description:
Senior Network Specialist – Core Infrastructure Platforms

We are moving our entire network and firewall estate to an automated, code-driven operating model, and we need someone who can help lead that shift. If Ansible, Terraform and Git workflows excite you more than console access, this role is built for you.

**The job

**

You will help design, build and operate the automation platform behind our entire network and firewall estate, moving us from manual, device-by-device changes to a version-controlled, peer-reviewed, GitOps-style way of working. As a technical anchor in Core Infrastructure Platforms, you will shape how the whole Infrastructure department approaches network automation.

In short, you can look forward to:

•    Driving network automation – help architecting, building and maintaining network automation for our Cisco and Palo Alto estate, replacing manual configuration with automated deployments.

•    Owning our network Source of Truth – building and operating the authoritative, version-controlled model of our intended network state (think Nautobot or Infrahub).

•    Designing CI/CD and Git – setting up pull requests, automated checks and review-gated deployments, and running the platforms

•    Running core network and SDN infrastructure – owning and optimising our datacenter and enterprise network, including Software-Defined Networking

**Joining the team

**

You will join our Infrastructure department, a small team coving everything infrastructure related.  We are in the beginning   of an ambitious shift from manual device configuration to a Source of Truth-driven, GitOps-style operating model, and you will have real influence over the architecture, tooling and practices we adopt next.

You will also act as a sparring partner and mentor to colleagues across Infrastructure, sharing what you build through documentation and peer review so good ideas do not stay with just one person.

**Your qualifications

**

You have a solid networking foundation combined with hands-on experience in modern network automation. You are comfortable working across Cisco and Palo Alto platforms, treating infrastructure as code with tools such as Ansible or Terraform, building CI/CD pipelines and using Git. We are interested in the strengths you bring across the areas below. Your most important skills are:

•    Solid networking fundamentals (L2/L3, BGP, OSPF, EVPN, VXLAN) with hands-on experience in Cisco (IOS/NX-OS) and Palo Alto/Panorama, plus exposure to SDN paradigms such as Cisco ACI.

•    Hands-on experience with Ansible or Terraform applied to network infrastructure.

•    Experience designing or operating CI/CD pipelines and using Git

•    Scripting skills in Python or Jinja2, with comfort working with APIs.

On a personal level, you are a proactive team player who shares what you build, a problem solver with an eye for detail, and someone who would rather automate a problem away than solve it the same way twice.

Professional proficiency in English is required; Danish is an advantage.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years, as we work with security-classified projects.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

Your key tasks will include:

•    Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes

•    Understanding of microservices and message queues

•    Solid software engineering practices: testing, logging, observability, and version control.

For senior profiles, we also expect:

•    5+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years focused on LLM or AI systems, building and deploying AI-powered applications in Java and Python

•    Hands-on experience with an orchestration framework, and a strong understanding of RAG architectures, vector databases, embedding models, hybrid search, and function-calling patterns
